display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig 共用教师指导连续实数融合筛查
description: 共同物理特征网络输出逐包实数权重，将实增益与 R17 连续融合；冻结教师在合法源 U 模拟配对上从五个权重中生成 KL 最优伪标签。
authorization: 用户于 2026-11-28 明确授权两数据集源域教师指导训练；只用各自合法源 U 模拟 clean/受扰配对，隐藏 U 的 TX 真值，禁止源 V 和目标参与训练。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI CUDA FP32 / TF32 off, CPU independent scorer

data.contract_ref: lora_rx5_main_v1:392005; ManySig Main original 7/63/30 F0 seed392005; VALIDATED_ONCE source caches
data.representation: same SharedPacketMixture, physical residual features and teacher-grid KL pseudo-target; LoRa 8x1024 and WiSig 8x32 with independent source-matched experts, frozen teachers and weights
data.physical_ids_ref: existing first cross-data screen physical IDs, same paired channel observations
data.exposure: same source V RX panels and historical comparisons repeatedly exposed by prior development; no target input or truth

permissions.claim_scope: Explicit user-authorized source-U classifier-guided training. Frozen LoRa W24 E104 / WiSig Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0 default heads supply KL-selected mixture-weight pseudo-labels; no U TX, V, target IQ/truth/statistics, classifier update or cross-dataset weight transfer. Deployment uses only current IQ, experts and action.

checkpoint.initialization: Independently initialized same zero-logit packet network; sigmoid initial real-gain weight 0.5 and R17 weight 0.5. Parents and teachers frozen.

sources.role: WiSig original full R17 and action
LoRa E104 real-gain screen comparison only
WiSig frozen DURA v1 same-packet screen predictions
frozen same-ID LoRa-trained R69 architecture adaptation; distinct from original WiSig DURA v1 weights

checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source final step 1000. LoRa hard-scene net >=1 in each fixed half and clean >=-1 versus every available same-packet control including LoRa R69 adaptation. WiSig each half net >=2 and clean >=-2 against each control including fixed DURA v1. Original fixed WiSig DURA v1 checkpoint has no lawful matched LoRa transfer; disclose as unavailable.

execution.gpu_policy: Two distinct GPUs from [3,6,4], each >=8192 MiB free; excludes GPUs 0/5/7/1 used by teacher-selector and matched control; preserve other owners.
execution.stop_rule: Stop affected run on provenance/data-contract mismatch, occupied immutable output, no source-only checkpoint smoke, nonfinite loss/gradient, prediction matrix mismatch, query or truth-boundary violation; preserve partial artifacts and all other processes.

rows.seed_notes: Support inapplicable; preregistered existing source V observations and fixed paired half permutation.

notes: User authorized two-dataset source teacher guidance. One SharedPacketMixture, physical features, KL grid target, training loss and inference rule, independently trained dataset weights and contracted experts/teachers.

For each U clean and simulated received packet, compute frozen F(clean) and F(r17+w*(real-r17)) for w in [0,.25,.5,.75,1]. Choose the minimal KL-to-clean weight, ties choose w=0. Use that soft target for BCE on predicted sigmoid w; repeat on clean input at 0.5 loss weight.

Original LoRa E104 teacher and real-gain parent carry supervised and U pseudo-label history. WiSig original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0 teacher carries its labeled/SSL history; WiSig real-gain parent is F-free. Candidate is F-guided training; no U TX, source V or target is read during fit.

1000 updates with 12 teacher forwards per source-U exposure: 48000 LoRa and 288000 WiSig teacher examples, plus ancestor costs. Finite-gradient real-expert and teacher smoke first; final source checkpoint fixed. Deployment uses no teacher or clean.

Repeatedly exposed source V panels retained. At registration the preceding hard teacher selector WiSig score and earlier screens were already visible, so this is development evidence, not blind; identical physical packets/controls and fixed per-half screening/clean rule apply.
